task.summary: Avoid crediting suspended EMPIRICAL intermediate terms as completed evidence.
task.context: Merged DOC-F1 repair #49; prepare evidence a later model can use without the review chat. Q = S I I; I=🤍, K=🖤, S=🌿. Each head is applied to each fixture.
task.applicability: Signed EmpiricalWitness, correct fixture fingerprint, caller explicitly trusts the author, ATP budget 50 per side. Advice concerns normally returning fixture evaluations, not exception semantics or universal equivalence.

attempt.operation: Repeat the existing DOC-F1 regression module and read the merged repair plus remediation resolution.
attempt.conditions: Python 3.14.7, Darwin arm64; existing tests generate ephemeral signing keys and explicitly trust their public key. No key material retained. Current code only; old code and mutants not rerun.

observations.statement: Ledger attributes discovery to Claude floor-document review and a Codex repeat at 8fed8bb834e37c190bc512ebc74f9440e4a3e8fa. These are historical attributions, not verified model identities. Budget 50: heads I Q vs K Q I on Q suspended equally and audited pass; Q vs I Q on Q suspended differently and audited fail. Repair head 1bb50f66d801342aa74015220f26266062707843 merged as f10856708bb02122ff272edb2ffaaa5ec3d00d69 in PR #49.

Resolution reports 7/10 failures before repair, 10/10 after, five killed mutants, reviewer permutations and budget boundaries 0/1. It reports audit pass→unverified, host CLI exit 0→1 and PDF PASS→UNVERIFIED. LI-2 and promotion unchanged; reward paths source-read only. None of these historical differential/mutant/consumer runs was repeated for this record.

Current existing module: 10 tests, exit 0. Its precondition test confirms equal and unequal SUSPENDED/SUSPENDED shapes, SETTLED/SUSPENDED and a settled mismatch. Audit cases confirm both suspended shapes and both asymmetric suspension shapes give unverified; settled agreement gives pass, settled mismatch fail. Both fixture orders preserve fail for a settled mismatch mixed with suspension, and unverified for agreement mixed with suspension.

Cause and repair: the EMPIRICAL branch now checks both is_settled() results before comparing canonical_bytes. It collects unsettled fixtures and continues, so a later settled mismatch still yields fail; otherwise accumulated suspension yields unverified; full settled agreement yields pass. The Git repair is present in the pinned source.

The EMPIRICAL fixture loop still catches exceptions and returns fail (Fixture execution failed). This record does not establish that such a fail is a checked mathematical negative. The ledger explicitly leaves alignment with other branches unresolved. Exception behavior was not runtime-probed here.

evidence.locator: generate_keypair and signatures used by tests

interpretation: Matching or differing intermediate terms from an exhausted budget do not establish agreement or refutation. The repair keeps searching past suspension because a separately completed mismatch is still useful negative evidence. This is an explanation of a bounded regression, not a proof about every evaluator.
advice: When changing EMPIRICAL comparison, retain the completion precondition on both sides and the mixed-fixture order controls. Do not return unverified immediately at the first suspended fixture: it can mask a later settled mismatch. Recheck the current revision and conditions before applying this advice. Treat exception semantics as a separate unresolved decision.
limits: Only existing DOC-F1 regression tests were rerun; no fresh adversarial mutation campaign or independent-model confirmation.
Historical pre-fix results, downstream CLI/PDF differences, five mutants and reviewer extras remain reported evidence.
No full suite, security audit, admission/reward measurement, network model calls, OTS or publication was performed.
Fixture exceptions remain fail; do not generalize the normal-return ordering rule to all error paths.
The Git commit pins repository source, not an exhaustive environment/dependency attestation. Runtime is recorded in replay.json; ephemeral keys and test duration need not reproduce byte-for-byte.
No experience CLI, indexing, signatures or actual cross-model transfer demonstrated; this is a new unsigned data record.
